entry_state: Bootstrap validation must match the chosen horizon, conditioning and centering. Even a justified payment law leaves the insurer's compensation method and tolerance to choose. A discrete tail calculation must retain the required portion of probability at its quantile boundary.
exit_state: Expected shortfall includes only the required mass at the cutoff; cumulative coverage is not always an exact quantile-equivalent level. A survival transform defines a different risk measure with nonnegative weights derived from the decreasing survival function.
findings: The upper forty-percent average is 31/4, distinct from strict-tail mean 10 and inclusive-tail mean 7.
The value 31/4 is not a quantile of the three-point law even though its cumulative coverage is three quarters.
The transformed finite weights are nonnegative, telescope to one and recover the original probabilities at rho equal one. Signed cash flows require another method. No new defect observed.
